notes: Both *it*s (after *spoken* and *do*) are supplied objects with no object morpheme in their clauses, so each is its own `added` unit under rule 44.
The negatives divide as two waw+לֹא fusions to *neither* (rule 35) beside a bare לֹא taking *not*; no written correlative pair stands here, so rule 14's correlative split does not engage.
